decisions.decision: Board determined it would not require septic testing on each individual lot at the Aro Estates property until a septic system is to be installed; a lot not supporting a fully compliant septic system and variance-free well would be deemed unbuildable.
decisions.quote: the board determined that they would not require testing on each individual lot until such time as a septic system was to be installed.

decisions.decision: For 6 Oakridge Road, Agent Garreffi will re-inspect and report back; the board will rehear the matter if issues remain unaddressed.
decisions.quote: the board advised that since it was ready for re-inspection, agent garreffi would report back to the board.

decisions.decision: Chairman advised that when Aro Estates plans are formally filed with the Planning Board, they must also be filed with the Board of Health, which will respond directly to the applicant and notify the Planning Board.
decisions.quote: chairman stated that when mr. o'brien formally files his plans with the planning board he is also required to file same with the board of health.
